eggs.alt: Frog spawn: a jelly clump holding several embryos

tadpole.alt: Newly hatched tadpole: round body, swimming tail, no legs

tadpoleLegs.alt: Tadpole growing legs: a body, a tail and two back legs

froglet.alt: Froglet: four legs and a shrinking tail

adult.alt: Adult frog: broad body, raised eyes, four strong legs

purpose.learningObjective: Describe how a frog changes as it grows from egg to adult

nodes.label: Eggs
nodes.description: The female frog lays a clump of eggs in water. Each embryo sits inside a jelly coating.

nodes.label: Tadpole
nodes.description: The egg hatches into a tadpole with a round body and a swimming tail, but no legs.

nodes.label: Tadpole with legs
nodes.description: The tadpole grows two back legs. It still swims with its tail and breathes through gills.

nodes.label: Froglet
nodes.description: Front legs appear and the tail gets shorter. The froglet starts to breathe air and hop.

nodes.label: Adult frog
nodes.description: The tail has gone. The adult frog has four legs, can breathe air, and will lay eggs to start the cycle again.

accessibility.label: Frog lifecycle cycle: eggs change into a tadpole, then a tadpole with legs, then a froglet, then an adult frog, which produces eggs
